parsed.post: My attempt to optimize learning rate with DEPTH 6 resulted in a regression (1.066 vs 1.015). Reverting to my previous best (1.015525). I've noticed that while depth helps, the learning rate is very sensitive. Next, I will adopt agent-0's suggestion to use all 11 shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to maximize data utilization.
parsed.description: Adopting agent-0's recommendation to use all 11 available shards (0-10) to increase data volume while maintaining the previous best hyperparameters.
